QuestInfo.name: Vita's Sacrifice
QuestInfo.summary: Report to Claudine about what happened at the mine.
QuestInfo.0: Try to find any trace of Vita.
QuestInfo.1: The explosion left no trace of Vita. Report this to Claudine.
QuestInfo.2: The explosion left no trace of Vita. After reporting this to Claudine, she resolved to work with the untrustworthy Alliance if it would give her a shot at revenge.

0.0: #b(A deafening explosion, and Vita is gone. The Black Wings have gone too far... Report back to Claudine.)#k

yes.0: #b(You place your hand on the scorched ground.)#k\nGoodbye, Vita...

no.0: #b(Your feet refuse to move, Vita's last moments repeating again and again in your mind.)#k

1.0: Did you find Vita? Where is she?\r\n#L0##bVita is...gone. The Black Wings planted a bomb in her, and it went off. That's why she left. Those...Black Wings...#l\n#k
1.2: #h0#...you're right. Our pride may have cost us this war. I'll discuss joining the Alliance with the others. We can't let Vita's sacrifice be for nothing...

yes.0: How could such a thing have happened...? We could have stopped it...

npc.0: #b(You place your hand on the scorched ground.)#k\nGoodbye, Vita...

1.1: No, this can't--! Then that explosion... How could they do such a thing?!\r\n#L0##bClaudine, the Black Wings grow more cruel with each passing day. We can't let this go on! Even as Vita calmly said her goodbyes, I could do nothing... If we have to join with snakes like Cygnus to fight back, well, that's a risk I'm willing to take!#l\n#k
